text:
mike_support: getting multiple reports that the token-cost dashboard is showing $0 or NaN for a small set of orgs (acme-inc, betterlabs, tiny-startup). Started after the nightly reconciliation job around 00:05 UTC. anyone seen this before?

joel_sre: thanks — can you paste one org id and a quick repro link? also any common trait (reserved capacity, subaccounts)?

mike_support: org ids: org_8421 (acme-inc), org_9932 (betterlabs). They all have reserved capacity flags set. repro: open /console/orgs/org_8421/costs -> token cost column shows NaN. Screenshot: https://img.redwood.internal/snap/ok123 (shared)

devin_billing: looks like the reconciliation job emits a metric with denominator 0 in some cases. I pulled a sample from raw_ledger:

```
SELECT org_id, sum(tokens) as tokens, sum(cost_cents) as cents
FROM raw_ledger
WHERE org_id = 'org_8421' AND period = '2026-03-17'
GROUP BY org_id;
```

Result: tokens = 0, cents = 0 -> our UI computes cents/tokens -> NaN or 0 depending on frontend guardrails.

lisa_prod: :thinking_face: is it safe to change frontend to show 0 instead of NaN? But we should fix upstream so those rows don't exist. Can we check whether tokens=0 but there are non-token charges (e.g., fixed reserved fee) getting mis-attributed?

devin_billing: checked: reserved_fee_cents is set on invoice table but reconciliation left ledger rows with tokens=0 and cost_cents=0 when we move reserved fees to invoice level. So double-mapping bug: the reconcile job zeroes out token lines instead of dropping them.

joel_sre: OK. Immediate mitigation: update frontend to coalesce NaN -> "0.00" for token cost cell and add a warning tooltip linking to status. I'll open a quick PR.

mike_support: can you also add a fallback for historical charts? Support getting a bunch of angry customers who see gaps. I'll craft a templated reply.

alert-bot: INCIDENT CREATED: INC-2026-0317-01 — assigned to eng-billing oncall (joel_sre). Severity: P2.

joel_sre: next steps: 1) hotfix frontend coalesce (5m), 2) hotpatch reconcile job to skip writing zeroed token rows (15-30m), 3) run targeted backfill for affected orgs (longer). I'll coordinate with billing to run backfill window 00:00-03:00 UTC.

devin_billing: I pushed a quick reconcile patch to staging that drops rows where tokens=0 and reserved_fee moved to invoice. Running test run now.

lisa_prod: thanks. mike_support — please keep customer thread updated: say we're aware, temporary display fix deployed, full data backfill scheduled and ETA will be provided.

mike_support: will do. sending initial update now.

joel_sre: logging follow-up: I found a handful of orgs with tokens=null (not 0) in the ledger export, which became NaN in the front end. Added null->0 cast in the pipeline and a schema assertion to fail if tokens is null. Rolling to prod in 10m.

mike_support: awesome. I'll close the support escalation once backfill finishes. Thanks team :heart:
